## Answer

**Choice C:** $a^{n-1}$.

Because $|A|=a\ne 0$, the matrix $A$ is invertible and

$$A^*=|A|A^{-1}.$$

Taking determinants on both sides gives

$$|A^*|=|A|^n|A^{-1}|=|A|^{n-1}=a^{n-1}.$$

## Answer

$$|A+B|=40.$$

The columns of $A+B$ are

$$A+B=(\alpha+\beta,\ 2\gamma_2,\ 2\gamma_3,\ 2\gamma_4).$$

By multilinearity of the determinant,

$$\begin{aligned}
|A+B|&=2^3|\alpha+\beta,\gamma_2,\gamma_3,\gamma_4|\\
&=8\left(|\alpha,\gamma_2,\gamma_3,\gamma_4|+|\beta,\gamma_2,\gamma_3,\gamma_4|\right)\\
&=8(|A|+|B|)=8(4+1)=40.
\end{aligned}$$

## Answer

$$\left|(3A)^{-1}-2A^*\right|=-\frac{16}{27}.$$

Since $|A|=\frac12$,

$$A^*=|A|A^{-1}=\frac12A^{-1},$$

so

$$(3A)^{-1}-2A^*=\frac13A^{-1}-A^{-1}=-\frac23A^{-1}.$$

The matrix is of order $3$, hence

$$\left|-\frac23A^{-1}\right|=\left(-\frac23\right)^3|A^{-1}|=-\frac8{27}\cdot\frac1{|A|}=-\frac{16}{27}.$$

## Answer

$$|B^{-1}-E|=24.$$

Because $A$ and $B$ are similar, $B$ has the same eigenvalues as $A$:

$$\frac12,\quad\frac13,\quad\frac14,\quad\frac15.$$

Therefore the eigenvalues of $B^{-1}-E$ are

$$2-1,\quad3-1,\quad4-1,\quad5-1,$$

namely $1,2,3,4$. Their product is the determinant:

$$|B^{-1}-E|=1\cdot2\cdot3\cdot4=24.$$

## Answer

$$|B|=\frac19.$$

First,

$$|A|=\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{vmatrix}=3,$$

so $A$ is invertible and $|A^*|=|A|^{3-1}=9$. Rearranging the given equation,

$$ABA^*-2BA^*=(A-2E)BA^*=E.$$

Also,

$$A-2E=\begin{pmatrix}0&1&0\\1&0&0\\0&0&-1\end{pmatrix},\qquad |A-2E|=1.$$

Taking determinants gives

$$|A-2E|\,|B|\,|A^*|=1,$$

therefore $|B|=1/(1\cdot9)=\frac19$.

## Answer

$$|B|=2.$$

Write $B=AC$, where the coefficient matrix is

$$C=\begin{pmatrix}1&1&1\\1&2&3\\1&4&9\end{pmatrix}.$$

Thus

$$|C|=\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\1&2&3\\1&4&9\end{vmatrix}=2.$$

Using $|A|=1$,

$$|B|=|A|\,|C|=1\cdot2=2.$$

## Answer

$$|B|=2.$$

From $BA=B+2E$,

$$B(A-E)=2E.$$

Here

$$A-E=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\-1&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad |A-E|=2,$$

so $A-E$ is invertible and $B=2(A-E)^{-1}$. Since these are matrices of order $2$,

$$|B|=|2(A-E)^{-1}|=2^2|(A-E)^{-1}|=\frac4{|A-E|}=2.$$
